title: Paranoid (2009 Remaster)
lyrics:
[00:11.99]Finished with my woman
[00:14.12]'Cause she couldn't help me with my mind
[00:17.78]People think I'm insane
[00:20.04]Because I am frowning all the time
[00:35.46]All day long, I think of things
[00:37.99]But nothing seems to satisfy
[00:41.24]Think I'll lose my mind
[00:43.10]If I don't find something to pacify
[00:48.59]Can you help me
[00:51.45]Occupy my brain?
[00:55.16]Whoa, yeah
[01:10.68]I need someone to show me
[01:13.23]The things in life that I can't find
[01:16.58]I can't see the things that make true happiness
[01:20.65]I must be blind
[01:57.56]Make a joke and I will sigh
[02:00.24]And you will laugh and I will cry
[02:03.44]Happiness, I cannot feel
[02:06.06]And love to me is so unreal
[02:21.11]And so as you hear these words
[02:23.71]Telling you now of my state
[02:26.96]I tell you to enjoy life
[02:29.61]I wish I could, but it's too late
